description: Prism and reviewer provider policy. It records temporary freezes, routing principles, and evidence requirements without encoding static model-family bias.
routing_principles: Rank providers by model capability profile plus local CLI stability evidence.
Separate installed/configured visibility from bounded live headless health.
Temporary freezes override ranking because they represent explicit resource or quota constraints.
When a provider is frozen, health probes must report frozen without executing the CLI command.
Copilot CLI is a protected fallback only: Prism, stop-review, live-health, baton delegation and direct RedCap CLI launch may use it only when both Claude Code and Kimi are unavailable.
Codex CLI is a last-resort fallback only: if any non-Codex provider is live-available, normal Prism rosters must suppress Codex.

routing_overrides.reason: User explicitly reserves Copilot CLI quota. RedCap may call Copilot only after Claude Code and Kimi are both unavailable.
User explicitly asked to lower Codex CLI priority and use it only when all other CLI providers are unavailable.

freeze_windows.reason: User explicitly reserved Copilot CLI quota until the monthly freeze window ends.

communication_packet.raw_output_policy: Keep raw evidence in run-scoped ignored storage when needed; promote only parsed verdict and report summary into tracked evidence.
communication_packet.fallback_policy: If provider quorum cannot be reached without frozen or unhealthy providers, record resource-limited Prism instead of silently weakening the claim.
